english.title: Proprietor of hackney carriage / PHV failing to produce insurance policy for inspection - outside Greater London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of

(A)_[a hackney carriage]_
(B)_[a private hire vehicle]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), licensed by **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT COUNCIL..), failed without reasonable excuse to produce for inspection the certificate of the policy of insurance or security required by Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 in respect of the vehicle at the request of an authorised officer of the council
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 50(4) and (5) and 76 Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
